detaileddescription.para: Runs the YMODEM handshake, processes Block 0 header, accepts data packets, verifies CRCs, and invokes event callbacks until all files in the batch are transferred or an unrecoverable error occurs.

simplesect.para: SYN_YMODEM_OK on successful session completion, or error code (<0).
